    及新興風險及風險管理活動；及                   periodic risk discussions among senior management; and


•   檢討主要業務策略及計劃，以評估其對         •      reviewing the key business strategies and initiatives to assess
    本公司整體風險定位的影響。                    their impact on the Company’s overall risk position.


風險管理程序                        Risk Management Process

除董事會的監管責任外，本公司亦設計出風險          In addition to the Board’s oversight responsibilities, the Company has
管理程序，以識別、評估及管理重大風險，並          developed a risk management process to identify, evaluate and manage
解決重大內部監控缺陷（如有）。高級管理層透         significant risks and to resolve material internal control defects (if any).
過本公司的內部審核部門負責年度風險呈報程          Senior management, through the Company’s internal audit department,
序。內部審核部門的成員與高級管理層若干成          is responsible for the annual risk reporting process. Members of the
員會面，檢討及評估風險，並探討重大內部監          internal audit department meet with various members of the senior
控缺陷（如有）的解決方案，包括有關年度適用         management to review and assess risks and discuss solutions to address
的任何變動，對風險進行匯總、評級並記錄緩          material internal control defects (if any), including any changes relevant
解計劃。風險評估乃由高級管理層若干成員進          to a given year. Risks are compiled, ratings are assigned and mitigation
行回顧，提呈審核委員會及董事會以供檢討。          plans are documented. The risk assessment is reviewed by certain
                              members of senior management and presented to the Audit Committee
                              and the Board for their review.


董事會及高級管理層根據(i)本公司財務業績風        Risks are evaluated by the Board and senior management based on (i)
險影響的嚴重程度、(ii)風險發生的概率，及(iii)   the severity of the impact of the risk on the Company’s financial results,
風險可能發生的速率或速度評估風險。             (ii) the probability that the risk will occur, and (iii) the velocity or speed
                              at which the risk could occur.

  成本及持有及開發有關的物業至竣工所需的估計利潤率）的使
  用。
  The Group determined fair value of the investment
  properties based on the results of valuations done
  by independent professional qualified valuers. The
  determination of fair value involved significant accounting
  judgements and estimates, including selection of valuation
  method, and usage of key inputs, such as current rental,
  estimated future rental, term yield, reversionary yield,
  estimated construction costs to completion, and estimated
  profit margin required to hold and develop property to
  completion.

      變動作出調整。                                          unused tax losses.

      營運及產生應課稅收入的國家於報告期                                tax laws enacted or substantively enacted at the end of the

      算。管理層就適用稅務法例受詮釋所規                                subsidiaries operate and generate taxable income. Management
      限的情況定期評估報稅表的狀況，並在                                periodically evaluate positions taken in tax returns with respect
      適用情況下根據預期須向稅務機關繳納                                to situations in which applicable tax regulation is subject to
      的稅款設定撥備。                                         interpretation and establishes provisions where appropriate on
                                                       the basis of amounts expected to be paid to the tax authorities.

   2.26 撥備及或然負債                                   2.26 Provisions and contingent liabilities

          倘本集團因過往事件而現時須承擔法定                               Provisions are recognised when: the Group has a present legal or
          或推定責任，且履行該等責任可能須動                               constructive obligation as a result of past events; it is more likely
          用 資 源， 及 所 涉 及 的 金 額 能 可 靠 估 計                  than not that an outflow of resources will be required to settle
          時，則確認撥備。未來營運虧損毋須確                               the obligation; and the amount has been reliably estimated.
          認撥備。                                            Provisions are not recognised for future operating losses.


          倘存在多項相若責任時，履行該等責任                               Where there are a number of similar obligations, the likelihood
          是否需要動用資源在考慮整體責任之類                               that an outflow will be required in settlement is determined by
          別後釐定。即使同一類別之任何一項責                               considering the class of obligations as a whole. A provision is
          任可能須動用資源的可能性極低，亦須                               recognised even if the likelihood of an outflow with respect to
          確認撥備。                                           any one item included in the same class of obligations may be
                                                          small.


          撥備按管理層對於報告期間結算日對須                               Provisions are measured at the present value of management’s

      項並非由本集團全權控制之日後不明朗                                occurrence or non-occurrence of one or more uncertain future

           乃假設該等物業各自按現況交吉出售。                               and investment approach, respectively. Direct comparison
           經參考有關市場的可資比較銷售交易，                               approach assumes sale of each of these properties in its existing
           選擇鄰近地區的可資比較物業並就位置                               state with the benefit of vacant possession. By making reference
           及物業規模等因素的差異作出調整；投                               to sales transactions as available in the relevant market,
           資法計及已產生建設成本及完成該開發                               comparable properties in close proximity have been selected and
           項目將產生的成本以反映已竣工開發項                               adjustments have been made to account for the difference in
           目的質量，依據是該物業將根據本集團                               factors such as locations and property size; Investment approach
           最近開發計劃予以開發和完成。就已竣                               has taken into account the construction costs incurred and the
           工投資物業而言，估值乃根據投資法透                               costs that will be incurred to complete the development to reflect
           過將來自現有租約的淨租金收入（在計                               the quality of the completed development on the basis that the
           及物業未來可享有的潛在收入增長後）                               properties will be developed and completed in accordance with

            入當期損益之金融負債                                     through profit and loss
            於2018年2月13日，本集團發行於2019                         On 13 February 2018, the Group issued convertible bonds due
            年2月10日 到 期 的 可 換 股 債 券， 金 額 為                  on 10 February 2019 amounting to HKD2,346 million (equivalent

            百萬元）。該等可換股債券可於發行日期                             could be converted into the Company’s share at HKD10.496
            後四十一天至到期日期前七天轉換為每                              per share from 41 days after issue date to 7 days before

            年2.25%。                                        2.25% per annum.


            本公司發行的可換股債券包括債務、提                              Convertible bonds issued by the Company includes debt, early
            早贖回權及換股權部分。於發行日期，                              redemption option and conversion option components. At the

            量且其變動計入損益金融負債。                                 a financial liability at fair value through profit and loss.


            本集團首先透過釐定由於市場情況而導                              The Group determines the amount of fair value changed which
            致市場風險增加之變動，以及其後將該                              are attributable to credit risk, by first determining the changes
            等變動自可換股債券之公允價值之變動                              due to market conditions which give rise to market risk, and
            總額中扣除，以釐定信貸風險所造成的                              then deducting those changes from the total change in fair value
            公允價值變動金額。造成市場風險增加                              of the convertible debentures. Market conditions which give
            之市場情況包括利率基準之變動。附帶                              rise to market risk includes changes in the benchmark interest
            嵌入式衍生工具之換股權的公允價值變                              rate. Fair value movements on the conversion option embedded
            動計入市場風險公允價值變動評估中。                              derivative are included in the assessment of market risk fair value
                                                           changes.


            由於除基準利率之變動外，構成可換股                              The Group believes that this approach most faithfully represents
            債券公允價值因素之變動並不被視為重                              the amount of change in fair value due to the Group’s own
            大，故本集團認為該方法能最忠實呈列                              credit risk, as the changes in factors contributing to the fair
            因本集團自身信貸風險而造成之公允價                              value of the convertible debentures other than changed in the
            值變動金額。                                         benchmark interest rate are not deemed to be significant.
